data.plainLyric:
Tell me you love me, that you'll always want me
Say you'll always love it when I talk this way
Tell me you'll be there when I need you the most
Hold me close when the night turns to day

Tell me your lies, babe, your sweet little lies
Fill my heart with sweetness with the words that you say
Been seeking the truth all of my youth
The truth means nothing when you look this way
Tell me your lies

Tell me you'll always be right here forever
That you had them, but you want me better
Tell me everything that you ever said
Was just another excuse for what you meant instead
Tell me all the times that you said I'm enough
Wasn't just another fickle form of love

Tell me your lies, babe, your sweet little lies
Fill my heart with sweetness with the words that you say
Been seeking the truth all of my youth
Truth means nothing when you look this way
Tell me your lies in this house that you built
Shameless when it comes to your sex and your guilt
Tell me your lies
Oh, tell me your lies

I'll let you believe I'll never leave you without warning
And I'll say anything just to see your little smile
How I'll be here in the morning
Now I'll be here for a while

Tell me the truth when it's hardest to say
Even if it means that you're leaving this way
Hold me close as this night turns to day
Then walk away, just walk away

Tell me your lies, babe, your sweet little lies
Fill my heart with sweetness with the words that you say
Been seeking the truth all of my youth
Truth means nothing when you look that way
Tell me your lies
Tell me your lies

Tell me your lies (tell me your lies)
Tell me your lies
